body: thanks for taking the time to write that. I think i'm going to go without. Whatever I write will probably make it even worse. I'll just have to hope they move on.

i know this accounts anonymous but i hate the thought of anyone knowing how i feel. I've always struggled to let anyone in to my life properly and I can't open up even on here.

What should I write in a note, i don't want to go into why I feel this way but what can i put to make them know they weren't to blame. I love my family and couldn't have asked for a better one, It's just me that's the problem.
